The HWPX document automation proposal succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, validating the LangChain graph implementation.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.66 across a 3-minute runtime. The pytest suite in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite passed all assertions without exceptions. While the graph logic is reusable, the discrepancy between the perfect verifier score and the lower judge reward suggests potential misalignment in qualitative output expectations.
